definition.title: The Long Shot
definition.briefing: Bryn has one cannon and a small escort. The quarry tower outranges the unprepared gun. Emplace the cannon on the western firing shelf, protect it from the Ironjaws, and destroy the marked tower.
definition.successText: The tower falls from the prepared shelf. Bryn brings the quarry workers inside the Mountain Keep before the warband returns.
definition.failureText: Bryn or the cannon is lost. Reset and prepare the firing position before engaging the tower.

objectives.text: Emplace at least one unit and destroy the quarry tower. Keep the cannon alive.
Keep Bryn Deepforge alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.
